cards.definition: dívida técnica — custo futuro de decisões técnicas ruins no presente
cards.example_sentence: The team has been struggling with technical debt for the past six months.

cards.definition: mentoria — orientação e desenvolvimento de profissionais
cards.example_sentence: She was promoted to tech lead because of her strong mentoring skills.

cards.definition: trade-off — equilíbrio entre vantagens e desvantagens
cards.example_sentence: Every architectural decision involves a trade-off between speed and reliability.

cards.definition: escalabilidade — capacidade de crescer para atender maior demanda
cards.example_sentence: Horizontal scaling improves throughput but doesn't always reduce latency.

cards.definition: RFC — documento de proposta de mudança técnica para revisão
cards.example_sentence: The RFC should clearly state the problem, the solution, and the trade-offs.

cards.definition: post-mortem — análise detalhada de um incidente após sua resolução
cards.example_sentence: The post-mortem documents what went wrong and how to prevent recurrence.

cards.definition: throughput — quantidade de trabalho processado por unidade de tempo
cards.example_sentence: We increased throughput by adding more worker nodes to the cluster.
